label: SR-10
title: Inspection of Systems or Components

statement.prose: Inspect the following systems or system components {{ insert: param, sr-10_odp.02 }} to detect tampering: {{ insert: param, sr-10_odp.01 }}.

guidance: The inspection of systems or systems components for tamper resistance and detection addresses physical and logical tampering and is applied to systems and system components removed from organization-controlled areas. Indications of a need for inspection include changes in packaging, specifications, factory location, or entity in which the part is purchased, and when individuals return from travel to high-risk locations.

params.label: systems or system components
guidelines: systems or system components that require inspection are defined;

params.label: frequency
guidelines: frequency at which to inspect systems or system components is defined (if selected);

params.label: indications of need for inspection
guidelines: indications of the need for an inspection of systems or system components are defined (if selected);
